raster.shadow_projection: Same camera projection, root and PPU. Camera-facing visual plane offset toward camera by 0.50 m; shadow plane by 0.51 m (-forward * distance). This is depth-only registration: orthographic screen position unchanged. Prevents floor clipping at front supports; not a physical displacement of the furniture root.
raster.formula_relative_to_root: u_px = D * dx; v_up_px = D * (cos(12deg)*dy + sin(12deg)*dz); image y_down = anchor_pixel_y - v_up_px
raster.pivot: metadata ground_anchor_px=[x,y] measured from top-left pixel edges; importer pivot=(x/width,1-y/height). Anchor may lie on transparent pixel. Report all four projected supports. Do not infer pivot from alpha bounds.
raster.export: Native gameplay density D. Transparent RGBA. Arbitrary tightly padded per-item canvas; record size and semantic anchor. No down/up-scaling individual objects to fit legacy rectangles. Higher-res masters allowed; if export density differs, declare density and use uniform PPU equal to that density.
raster.depth_registration_note: Export projection/density/dimensions unchanged. Depth offset along camera.forward has zero projected displacement. All sprite groups remain order -10, behind hero order 0.

layering.furniture: all behind static character path; no foreground occlusion split needed for this batch
layering.hero: preserve SpriteRenderer sortingOrder=0; use geometric camera depth for furniture-vs-hero, all furniture sprites remain behind hero plane. Furniture orders 10/20 are within a SortingGroup with sortingOrder=-10; hero stays 0.
layering.per_item: SortingGroup on root order=-10; inside group visual=10 desk/bed,20 chair; shadow=visual-1. Groups sort by root camera distance; chair root closer than desk.
layering.shadows: only local contact support of that item, projected into its own layer, no floor patch/neighbouring shadow. Transparent Sprite-Unlit material. Baked form shading acceptable, dynamic relighting not proven.
